pipeline: GTFSデータリポジトリでフィードを探して取得する
作品①で山口県の登録供給、公式GTFS確認状況、日付、限界を市町別に揃える
GTFS-GOでGTFS内部の停留所、経路、運行頻度を可視化する
LINKS Mobilysで乗降実績やODを加え、計画分析とシナリオ検討を行う
synthesis.positioning: Work 1 is an upstream evidence and handoff layer for municipality-level pre-consultation checks, not a replacement for GTFS repositories, GIS visualization, or planning analysis.
synthesis.confirmed_distinction: Across the six reviewed primary sources, the same combination of four registration ledgers, official GTFS confirmation status, municipality entry points, date/provenance boundaries, and printable pre-consultation memo was not confirmed.
limits: Only three selected domestic services and six primary sources were reviewed.
Absence from reviewed descriptions is not evidence that a comparator lacks a feature.
No claim of uniqueness, superiority, national completeness, or award impact is made.
The internal award scorecard is unchanged.
next_product_questions: Can the handoff from Work 1 to deeper GTFS analysis be made clearer without duplicating those tools?
Which pre-consultation task should later be tested with relevant users?
